summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0). core-shell passes owner 'platform', billing 'payments', reports 'insights' (from package.json team; hardcoded since bundles can't read package.json). Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build, so no registry release/dependency bump needed and one PR is safe ordering-wise. Reports also called validateApp, so I fixed it too to avoid breaking it and to clear audit. PR #1 merged, CI/CD green, audit 0 violations.
